title: Pilot-API-Events
description: Logs, metrics and traces from the Pilot APIs (.NET, Java, Python, Utility) via OTEL.

options.content: **Pilot API telemetry** — every API exports OTLP to `otel-collector`, which fans out to **Mimir** (metrics), **Loki** (logs) and **Tempo** (traces). Signals share `service.name` (*job* / *service_name*) and `service.instance.id` (*instance*); each API runs twice (SQL Server + PostgreSQL), and the **API instances** table maps each instance id to its database. Log lines carry `trace_id` / `span_id`, so a log can be followed to its trace in Tempo, and a trace back to its logs and metrics.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Total HTTP requests served in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (job) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or sum by (job) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Current HTTP requests per second across the selected APIs.

panels.title: 5xx error rate
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status in the selected range.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (job) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (job) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / sum(sum by (job) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or sum by (job) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) * 100

panels.title: 4xx rate
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx status (validation, auth, not found) in the selected range.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (job) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (job) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / sum(sum by (job) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or sum by (job) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) * 100

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile server-side request duration over the selected range.

panels.title: Warnings / errors logged
panels.description: Log records at WARN level or above in the selected range.

panels.title: Requests by API instance
panels.description: Traffic, error share and latency for each running API instance over the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or sum by (job, instance) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

(sum by (job, instance) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (job, instance) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance", http_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))) / sum by (job, instance) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or sum by (job, instance) (increase(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) * 100
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, job, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

sum by (job, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / sum by (job, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: API instances (from traces)
panels.description: Maps each OTEL service.instance.id to the database it talks to (SQL Server or PostgreSQL), derived from the database client spans in Tempo. Use it to tell the two containers of each API apart.

targets.query: {resource.service.name=~"${service:regex}" && (span.db.system != nil || span.db.system.name != nil)} | count_over_time() by (resource.service.name, resource.service.instance.id, span.db.system, span.db.system.name)

panels.title: Request rate by API instance
panels.description: HTTP requests per second handled by each API instance.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (job, instance) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: Response mix per API. 2xx success, 4xx client/auth problems, 5xx server faults.

targets.expr: sum by (job, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (job, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95 latency by API instance
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration per instance. Diamonds are exemplars — click one to open that trace in Tempo.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, instance) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000

panels.title: Latency percentiles (all selected APIs)
panels.description: Median, p95 and p99 request duration per API.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Every route hit in the selected range (both database instances combined) with volume, failures and latency. Sorted slowest first.

targets.expr: sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: DB client call rate by API
panels.description: Outbound database calls per second, from Tempo span metrics (client spans). Covers every API, including Java (JDBC) which has no DB metrics of its own.

panels.title: DB client p95 latency by API
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of database client spans.

panels.title: .NET DB operation duration by database (p95)
panels.description: p95 from the SqlClient / Npgsql instrumentation (.NET APIs only), split by database engine.

panels.title: Slowest DB operations
panels.description: Database client spans grouped by operation (SQL verb + table) from Tempo span metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{service=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT"}[$__range])) / sum by (service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{service=~"$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Connection pool (.NET / Npgsql)
panels.description: Open vs. idle pooled connections reported by Npgsql (PostgreSQL .NET instances).

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: Requests currently being processed (concurrency).

panels.title: Kestrel connections (.NET)
panels.description: Open and queued connections in the ASP.NET Core Kestrel web server.

panels.title: Authorization attempts (.NET)
panels.description: ASP.NET Core authorization decisions per second (success / failure).

panels.title: JVM heap used (Java)
panels.description: Heap memory in use by the Java API JVMs.

panels.title: JVM CPU utilisation (Java)
panels.description: Recent CPU utilisation of the Java process (0–100% of available CPUs).

panels.title: JVM threads & GC (Java)
panels.description: Live thread count and time spent in garbage collection (ms per second).

panels.title: Log volume by API and level
panels.description: Log records per interval, stacked by API and severity.

panels.title: Top log sources
panels.description: Which loggers (OTEL instrumentation scopes) produce the most records.

panels.title: Warnings & errors
panels.description: Records at WARN or above. Expand a line to see trace_id / span_id and other OTEL attributes.

panels.title: Log stream
panels.description: All log records for the selected APIs, filtered by the 'Search logs' box. Bearer tokens are masked. Expand a line for trace_id, RequestPath, StatusCode, Elapsed and other fields.

panels.title: Recent requests (traces)
panels.description: Latest server-side request traces. Click a trace ID to open the full trace (HTTP span + DB spans + linked logs).

panels.title: Slow requests (> $slow_ms ms)
panels.description: Server spans slower than the 'Slow threshold' variable.

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Traces containing an error span or a 5xx response.

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Calls between the APIs and their databases, built from Tempo's service-graph metrics.

panels.title: Collector: accepted telemetry
panels.description: Telemetry received by otel-collector from all APIs.

panels.title: Collector: refused / failed
panels.description: Anything non-zero here means telemetry is being dropped before it reaches Loki / Mimir / Tempo.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_failed_spans_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
